_comment: 'When this is put face-up into your arsenal, IT gets go again this turn.' Go again is PRINTED, so the card DB granted it unconditionally and Swift Shot had go again however it was played -- the gate is the whole card. The grant machinery was already here and correct (GRANT_KEYWORD_TO_PLAYED filtered to this card played from arsenal); only the strip was missing. Declared rather than converted to a WHILE_STATIC because the condition is an EVENT -- being put face-up into arsenal -- with no state a static could read at attack time.
